fusions.name: Stampede Through Roots
fusions.desc: Roots gallop out through the ground in a cone, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 4% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Drumming Hardwood
fusions.desc: Hurls a hardwood stave that deals 28 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Canter Under Canopy
fusions.desc: Your movement speed rises by 35% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 5% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Rooted Gait
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%. You carry 6% earth resistance.
